hypothesis: Actual sift distance should explain priority-queue work better than maximum height or raw priority. Removing prompt length and using two causal expressions also reduces observation overhead.

pcvs.name: waiting_depth
pcvs.rationale: Captures queue-size-dependent insertion and allocation costs.

pcvs.expression: (1 if len(self.waiting) >= 1 and request < self.waiting._heap[(len(self.waiting) - 1) // 2] else 0) + (1 if len(self.waiting) >= 3 and request < self.waiting._heap[(len(self.waiting) - 3) // 4] else 0) + (1 if len(self.waiting) >= 7 and request < self.waiting._heap[(len(self.waiting) - 7) // 8] else 0)
pcvs.name: sift_levels
pcvs.rationale: Counts insertion ancestors outranked by the incoming request, giving the exact sift distance for the workload's heaps using at most three comparisons.
